title: BOOT CAMP
description: A two-minute guided tour of the terminal: the commands you need for every mission that follows.
goal: Follow MIRA's instructions step by step. Nothing here can go wrong.
hint: Do what the current objective says. 'hint' tells you the exact command.
story_start: MIRA: "Welcome to NEXUS, {player}. Before your first real job we do a short warm-up. It takes about two minutes."
MIRA: "Type the commands yourself. Each step tells you what to do, and 'hint' repeats the exact command."

objectives.text: Connect to the training node ECHO
Scan the node to see what runs on it
List the files in the root folder

objectives.hint: Type: cd training   then: cat lesson.txt   (or in one go: cat training/lesson.txt)

objectives.text: Find and read the hidden file in training/
objectives.hint: Type: ls -a   then: cat .keycard   (make sure you are inside the training folder: cd training)
Type: download field_notes.dat   (from inside the training folder)

story_end: MIRA: "That's the whole toolkit: connect, scan, ls, cd, cat, download, hint, disconnect. Everything else is built from these."
MIRA: "Your first real assignment is already loaded."
